texts.zh: [From.GetName]附近小行星的轨道是如此完美无暇地稳定，也不难理解为什么我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]会认为它是被人工放置在这个地方了。然而，那里也没有任何推进系统或者其他人工航行的迹象。唯一的自然演化结论是，由于某种几乎荒谬到不可能成真的几率，这颗小行星被[From.GetName]的重力场捕获了。我们在这颗小行星的表面还探测到了几种十分稀有的水晶。
texts.en: The asteroid around [From.GetName] has such a perfectly stable orbit that it's easy to understand why our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] thought it was placed there artificially. Yet, there are no conclusive indications of any propulsion systems or any other artificial marring. The only natural conclusion is that, by some absurdly improbable chance, the asteroid got caught in [From.GetName]'s gravity field. We have also detected some rare crystals on the surface of the asteroid.
